description: Drive one AI agent from another through kolu's terminals: spawn a Claude Code / Codex / opencode session in a PTY, prompt it, watch the screen for its reply, read it, and prompt again — a create→send→snapshot loop run with the `kaval-tui` CLI directly (no MCP). `kaval-tui` writes input and reads scrollback; `pulam-tui` adds a precise agent-state done-signal when you drive hooked terminals. Triggers on "drive another agent", "send a prompt to a terminal agent", "have one agent prompt another", "agent drives agent", "orchestrate agents in terminals", "make Claude drive Codex", "prompt the agent running in that terminal", or wiring a loop where one coding agent supervises another.
